record.paper_title: Some open problems in dynamical systems
record.original_question: Let G^∞_*(M) denote either the space of smooth measure-preserving diffeomorphisms of a compact manifold M or the space of smooth symplectic diffeomorphisms, and let SE^∞_* be the class of diffeomorphisms with uniformly positive stable Lyapunov exponents along periodic orbits in the sense defined in the paper. Is the subset of maps in G^∞_*(M) that admit a dominated splitting on all of M C^1-dense in SE^∞_*?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $M$ be a compact smooth manifold equipped with either a smooth volume form $\omega^n$ (volume case) or a smooth symplectic form $\omega$ (symplectic case). Denote by $\mathcal{G}^\infty_*(M)$ the space of $C^\infty$ diffeomorphisms of $M$ preserving the chosen structure (volume-preserving in the first case, symplectic in the second), endowed with the $C^1$ topology.

For $f\in\mathcal{G}^\infty_*(M)$ and a periodic point $p$ of period $\pi(p)$, let $\lambda_1(p)\le\dots\le\lambda_{\dim M}(p)$ denote the Lyapunov exponents of $Df^{\pi(p)}(p)$. A diffeomorphism $f$ is said to have uniformly positive stable Lyapunov exponents along periodic orbits if there exist constants $c>0$ and an index $0<k<\dim M$ such that for every hyperbolic periodic point $p$ of $f$, the stable Lyapunov exponents at $p$ satisfy $\lambda_i(p)\le -c$ for $i=1,\dots,k$ (and, in the symplectic case, $\lambda_{\dim M+1-i}(p)\ge c$ correspondingly). Let $SE^\infty_*$ denote the set of all such diffeomorphisms in $\mathcal{G}^\infty_*(M)$.

Recall that an $f$-invariant compact set $\Lambda\subset M$ admits a dominated splitting if there is a continuous $Df$-invariant decomposition $T_\Lambda M=E\oplus F$ with $E,F$ nontrivial, and constants $C>0$, $0<\lambda<1$ such that for every $x\in\Lambda$ and every $n\ge 0$,
$$\|Df^n|_{E(x)}\|\cdot\|Df^{-n}|_{F(f^n(x))}\|\le C\lambda^n.$$

Question: Is the set
$$\{f\in\mathcal{G}^\infty_*(M): f\text{ admits a dominated splitting on all of }M\}$$
$C^1$-dense in $SE^\infty_*$?
artifact.status_search_result: A search reveals substantial recent activity on $C^1$-density results in conservative and symplectic dynamics (e.g., Avila–Crovisier–Wilkinson on $C^1$ density of stable ergodicity; Bochi-type results connecting continuity of Lyapunov exponents with dominated splittings; Arbieto–Matheus and others on nonuniform hyperbolicity and global dominated splitting). However, no source was found that explicitly settles the precise question of $C^1$-density of globally dominated diffeomorphisms inside the class of smooth conservative/symplectic diffeomorphisms with uniformly positive stable periodic Lyapunov exponents. The status appears unresolved in full generality.

status_evidence.title: C^1 density of stable ergodicity (Avila–Crovisier–Wilkinson)
status_evidence.snippet: Stable ergodicity is C^1-dense among C^r partially hyperbolic volume-preserving diffeomorphisms.
status_evidence.claim: Related C^1-density results exist for partially hyperbolic conservative systems, but do not settle this specific question.

status_evidence.title: Nonuniform hyperbolicity, global dominated splittings
status_evidence.snippet: Studies relations between nonuniform hyperbolicity and existence of global dominated splittings for conservative diffeomorphisms.
status_evidence.claim: Connections between dominated splittings and stable exponents are an active topic, but the explicit density question is not resolved here.

status_evidence.title: C1-generic symplectic diffeomorphisms: partial hyperbolicity and zero centre Lyapunov exponents
status_evidence.snippet: For a residual subset of C^1 symplectic diffeomorphisms, either the diffeomorphism is Anosov or almost every point has a zero Lyapunov exponent of multiplicity at least 2.
status_evidence.claim: Related dichotomy between domination and zero exponents in the symplectic C^1-generic setting.
